_comment: Embedding model registry for session-corpus G7. Each entry declares the full contract.
_doc: Add an entry here before changing MODEL_ID in embed.py. schema_version_required must match the vec_embeddings DDL dims.

sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.notes: Offline-cached baseline. Chosen from local cache (HF token unavailable at G7 build time). Not benchmarked — convenience selection. Suitable for short-text similarity; not optimised for code retrieval.

nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5.notes: Matryoshka dims (64-768 usable). Requires HF token + local cache. 8192 ctx captures full session texts.

BAAI/bge-m3.notes: Dense + sparse + colbert hybrid. Multilingual. Requires HF token + local cache.

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding.notes: Flexible dims (64-4096 via Matryoshka). Multilingual. Top MTEB 2025-06. Requires HF token + local cache.

jinaai/jina-embeddings-v3.notes: Task-aware embeddings. Requires HF token + local cache.
